rooms.name: A Clearing In The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small clearing in the huge and primal forest of
Arden. All other forests you've ever seen were mere shadows of this
great wood. It appears dangerous and is rumoured to be the favorite
hunting grounds of Julian, a Prince of Amber. Beware that you don't
become his prey.

rooms.name: A Narrow Trail Through Arden
rooms.desc:
Here, an overgrown trail winds through the forest.  There are a few animal
track in the dirt here, several of which appear to be hoofprints. The
trail winds its way east and there is a clearing to the south.

rooms.name: A Trail In Arden
rooms.desc:
This narrow trail winds its way east and west through the heart of the
forest Arden.  There is a wide, quick-moving steam to the north, and the
forest extends in all other directions.

rooms.name: A Trail In Arden
rooms.desc:
The trail turns sharply to the north here, where it appears you can
ford the stream to the north by walking across a large, fallen tree. The
forest Arden surrounds you, and you can smell the faint scent of tea leaves
burning on the wind.

rooms.name: A Tree Fallen Over The Stream
rooms.desc:
It might be difficult, but you think that this might be your only way
of getting across the stream with dry feet.  You can definitely smell tea
brewing nearby, its scent carried by the winds coming from the northeast.

rooms.name: A Trail In Arden
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a wide trail, flanked on either side by tall
trees and shrubs.  A few chittering birds fly overhead, singing their
warbling tunes, while voles rustle the dried leaves around you.

rooms.name: Julian's Hunting Camp
rooms.desc:
This is the campsite of the legendary hunter and Prince of Amber,
Julian. There's a fire going in the center of the clearing and a pot
of coffee steaming above it. There are a few animal hides lying about.

rooms.name: A Trail In Arden
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a trail that splits the forest of Arden.  Off to
the southeast, you can see a campsite of some sort, though you cannot
tell if anyone is nearby.

rooms.name: Stream Under A Fallen Tree
rooms.desc:
You are splashing around in a shallow stream.  Just above your head is a
fallen tree that crosses the stream.  The stream gets rockier towards the
east, where you can see rapids, and seems to be calm west of here.  The
north and south banks appear to be too steep to climb.

rooms.name: Rocky Streambed
rooms.desc:
It's hard to move around here. The rocks make very uncertain footing. The
north and south banks are too steep to climb, but the sound of muted voices
drifts down from the north bank.

rooms.name: Stream
rooms.desc:
You are splashing around in a shallow stream. East of here, the steam
crosses under a tree which has fallen across it.  To the west, the stream
appears to branch in two directions.

rooms.name: A Trail In Arden
rooms.desc:
This is yet another trail in the massive forest of Arden.  To the north
you can see the top of a large mountain peeking out above the trees.
There is apparently a campsite of some sort to your south.

rooms.name: The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
This is a beautiful forest but there are so many trees, it's a little
difficult to walk around. There is a small shrine here.

rooms.name: The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
You wander through the forest Arden. The trees are lush and plentiful
here, and you can hear the endless banter of birds and other woodland
creatures.  The forest surrounds you in all directions.

rooms.name: The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
The pines and willows are beautiful and plentiful here.  Exits lead
into the forest to the north, south, and west, while the coast lies to
the east.

rooms.name: The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
The pines and willows are beautiful and plentiful here.  Exits lead
into the forest to the south and west, while the ocean's coast lies to
the north and east.

rooms.name: The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
There's a small stand of saplings here. There must have been a fire
here some time ago. There are more different kinds of trees here than
you've ever seen before.

rooms.name: The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in the forest Arden.  The trees are very tall here and
there is little undergrowth.  To the east, you can see a narrow, overgrown
trail.  To the north, a wide, quick-moving stream rushes by.  The forest
extends in all other directions.

rooms.name: A Fork In The Stream
rooms.desc:
The stream divides here and goes north, east, and west. There is a
deep pool to the north. You hear water falling.

rooms.name: A Cliff Above A Deep Pool
rooms.desc:
This is a beautiful and peaceful little clearing. The grasses are soft and
inviting. The imposing face of Mt. Kolvir is to the north. An overgrown drop
to the stream is to the south. The edge of the cliff is west of here.  Water
falls into a deep pool below there.

rooms.name: The Thin Air Above A Deep Pool
rooms.desc:
You're standing in the thin air above a deep pool! There must be a
powerful updraft here, generated by the waterfall to the north. A cliff
is to the east and there's nothing but treetops to the west and south.

rooms.name: A Deep Pool
rooms.desc:
A deep and swirling pool at the foot of a waterfall. It looks too 
turbulent for swimming. There's a stream to the south and the waterfall
is to the north.

rooms.name: A Ledge Behind The Waterfall
rooms.desc: This is a small ledge in the mountain behind the waterfall.

rooms.name: A Ledge Behind The Waterfall
rooms.desc: This a narrow ledge behind the waterfall.

rooms.name: A Ledge Behind A Waterfall
rooms.desc: This is a narrow ledge behind the waterfall. There's a cave to the north.

rooms.name: A Stream In Arden
rooms.desc:
This looks like the backwash from the steam. It eddies around here and goes
nowhere. The banks to the north and south can be climbed.

rooms.name: Tall Trees In Arden
rooms.desc:
Beautiful, healthy oaks and pines dominate the woods here.  All around
you, birds and squirrels chitter in their endless banter as they build
nests among the tall branches above.  The forest extends in all directions,
save the south, where a stream cuts through the forest.

rooms.name: Grand Trees In Arden
rooms.desc:
You are wandering through the heart of the forest Arden. Mt. Kolvir rises
sharply to the north above the massive pines and oaks that surround you in
every direction.

rooms.name: The Forest Arden
rooms.desc:
You wander though the forest Arden.  The abundance of lush, healthy plant
and wildlife is amazing.  Mt. Kolvir rises sharply to the north.  There
is a sharp dropoff to to the south.

rooms.name: The Grove Of The Unicorn
rooms.desc:
This is a peaceful grove between the foot of Mt. Kolvir and the primal
forest Arden.  It does not look like it occurred naturally, rather it
appears to have been crafted by a skilled horticulturalist. The forest
Arden is to your west.

rooms.name: A Sparkling Cave
rooms.desc:
The walls of this cave sparkle like silver and gold, but when you
chip a piece of the cave wall away, the shard you obtain looks more like
rough granite.  You must be in the heart of Mt. Kolvir.

rooms.name: A Sparkling Cave
rooms.desc:
The sparkling cave continues here, the sparkles reflecting the light
of your torch.  There is something odd about the ceiling here.

rooms.name: Corwin's Glen
rooms.desc:
This is a pretty little glen where birds probably sing, flowers probably
grown, and young lovers probably... love.  There is a small shrine here.

rooms.name: A Precarious Path Along The Precipice of Mount Kolvir
rooms.desc:
At your feet is the beginning of a path up the southern slope of Mount
Kolvir. Arden is to the south. A small glen is to the west. There is a
sign here.

rooms.name: A Precarious Path Along The Precipice of Mount Kolvir
rooms.desc:
This is a narrow path which allows to to climb northward up the face
of Mount Kolvir, or southward back into the forest Arden. You are still
not high enough to see over the tall trees of Arden, but you can see that
the path you are on scales up the mountain as far as you can see.

rooms.name: A Precarious Path Along The Precipice Of Mount Kolvir
rooms.desc:
The narrow path gets steeper here, and you find that you occasionally
need to look for handholds on the face of the mountain to pull yourself along.
You can see most of the forest Arden from this perspective, as well as
the ocean to the southeast.

rooms.name: A Precarious Path Along The Precipice Of Mount Kolvir
rooms.desc:
The path is so steep here that it could almost be defined as ruts cut into
the face of the mountain. A fall now would be horrifingly fatal. There
is a brass and stone historical marker embedded in the face of the mountain
here.

rooms.name: A Widening Path Along Mount Kolvir
rooms.desc:
The edge of the face of Mt. Kolvir is just below you, a narrow spiralling
ledge that only barely qualifies as a path is your only exit from the
mountain.  Here, the path widens some and extends to the north, although
movement here is still very uncomfortable.

rooms.name: A Precarious Path Along The Precipice Of Mount Kolvir
rooms.desc:
This wide section of path ends as abruptly as it began, another narrow
ledge spirals upward along the another face of Mt. Kolvir.  South of here
the path widens and then drops off down the main face of the mountain.

rooms.name: The Top Of Mount Kolvir
rooms.desc:
The path ends here at the broad roundtop of Mount Kolvir. To the north
the mountain slopes downward into a saddle, invisible from all angles
except this one.  There appears to be a fairly large town and a castle
secreted in the woods at the top of the mountain here.

rooms.name: Viewing Platform
rooms.desc:
This is a redwood deck that overhangs the southern edge of the top of
Mt. Kolvir. The view of Arden from here is breathtaking! You can also
see a long ways down the path between here and Arden. In fact, this
would be a great place from which to drop a rock on somebody.

rooms.name: A Fork In The Road To Amber
rooms.desc: This is a wide, paved road. There is a sign here.

rooms.name: Gate To The South Courtyard
rooms.desc:
This is the gateway to the southern courtyard of Castle Amber. The
castle sprawls in all its glory before you to the north.

rooms.name: Inside The South Gate
rooms.desc: A wide, paved area just inside the south gate.

rooms.name: Road To The City
rooms.desc: This is a tree-lined, well-maintained road leading to the city.

rooms.name: Road To The City
rooms.desc: This is a tree-lined, well-maintained road leading to the city.

rooms.name: The Road To The City
rooms.desc: This is the road to the city. The city is just north of here.

rooms.name: Seaward Street
rooms.desc:
This is the intersection of Seaward Street and Pearl Avenue. A guard
house stands on the east side of the road.

rooms.name: Seaward Street
rooms.desc:
A lighted street in the city of Amber. The bank is west and the jail
is east of here.

rooms.name: City Of Amber Guardhouse
rooms.desc:
This looks like a typical guardhouse. Tables and chairs are here and there.
Looks like a few "Wanted:" sketches are hanging on the back wall.

rooms.name: Pearl Avenue
rooms.desc:
This is a very nice-looking street. The city wall is to the south.
To your north stand a tall building.

rooms.name: First Bank Of Amber
rooms.desc:
A bank with a long counter of teller windows is here. Doors lead out
to the east and south. The vault is west of here.

rooms.name: Pearl Avenue
rooms.desc: This is a very nice street. The city wall is to the south.

rooms.name: City Of Amber Jail
rooms.desc: It's a small jail. There's a desk up front; the cages are in the back.

rooms.name: Seaward Street
rooms.desc: This is a street in Amber.

rooms.name: Deirdre Square
rooms.desc:
You are in a festive square in the city of Amber. Music fills the air
from the nearby Cafe. To the east is the city park. There is a statue
here of Deirdre, Princess of Amber. A gate leads east into a park.

rooms.name: Seaward Street
rooms.desc:
Seaward Street extends to the north and south, and there is a small cafe
to the west from which loud music is playing.

rooms.name: A Path Through The Park
rooms.desc:
This is a pretty little walking path through the park. A door leads
west out of the park and a gate leads east down a path.

rooms.name: Shell Avenue
rooms.desc: A city street running east and west.

rooms.name: Park
rooms.desc:
There are lots of trees here. It looks like a nice place for a picnic.
The park fence is to the west and the city wall is east.

rooms.name: Park Playground
rooms.desc:
This is a quiet play area for children.  A few deep tranches of orange
sand and a hole of firm mud provide tons of activities for children in this
tree-covered area.  The park fence is to the west and the city wall is east.

rooms.name: Small, Paved Path
rooms.desc: A small, paved path that runs east and west.

rooms.name: Shell Avenue
rooms.desc:
This is a city street running east and west. There is a quiet hall
north of here.

rooms.name: Cafe Amber
rooms.desc:
This restaurant and tavern plays host to the younger crowds of Amber.
A bard with a harsh, brassy voice bellows a bawdy tune about the trials
and sufferings of young love while patrons dance in erratic, irrythmic
motions, waving their hands in intricate semantics.

rooms.name: Church Of The Unicorn
rooms.desc:
You're in a small chapel, very lavishly decorated with tapestries depicting
various members of the royal family. There are some pews here. The altar is
west.

rooms.name: Oberon Center
rooms.desc:
This is a somewhat somber square in the city honoring Oberon. There is a
statue here.

rooms.name: Shell Avenue
rooms.desc:
This is a city street running east and west. There is an elegant oak
door to the north.

rooms.name: Shell Avenue
rooms.desc: This is a city street running east and west.

rooms.name: Inside West Gate Of Amber
rooms.desc: A round, cobblestoned area just inside the western gate of Amber.

rooms.name: Dirt Track By The Wall
rooms.desc: This is a rough trail that crewmen use for making repairs to the city wall.

rooms.name: Dirt Track By The Wall
rooms.desc: This is a rough trail that crewmen use in making repairs to the wall.

rooms.name: Dworkin Circle
rooms.desc:
This is a quiet square in the city of Amber honoring Dworkin. There is a
statue here.

rooms.name: Fishmonger's Road
rooms.desc:
This is a rather run-down road running east and west. The
smell of fish, booze, and blood is almost overpowering.

rooms.name: Fishmonger's Road
rooms.desc:
This is a rather run-down road running east and west. The smell
of fish, booze, and blood is almost overpowering. A sleazy shop
lies south of here.

rooms.name: Hardcase Mall
rooms.desc:
This is a boisterous little square honoring Hardcase. There is a
statue here.

rooms.name: Fishmonger's Road
rooms.desc:
This is a really seedy part of town but the restaurant to the south is
supposedly worth the trip. There is a wall of somekind to the north.

rooms.name: Fishmonger's Road
rooms.desc:
This is a really bad part of town. The docks are north. A restaurant is
south, but there is no door here.

rooms.name: Seaward Street
rooms.desc: There's a warehouse of some sort to the east.

rooms.name: Eric Court
rooms.desc:
This is a grimy little square honoring Eric. The docks are north.
Fishmonger's Road is west. Seaward Street is south. There is a statue here.

rooms.name: Bayle's Warehouse
rooms.desc:
This is a big warehouse. There's sawdust on the floor. Bottles of wine are
securely locked into rows and rows of wineracks.

rooms.name: Bayle's Warehouse
rooms.desc:
Actually, it's a huge warehouse. Are the Bayles selling any wine? There are
more locked racks of wine bottles here.

rooms.name: Hill Street
rooms.desc: This is a city street in decent repair running north and south.

rooms.name: Hill Street
rooms.desc:
This is a city street running north and south. You see the wall of some
building to the east. To the west is a tattoo parlor.

rooms.name: Hill Street
rooms.desc:
This street is brightly lighted by the facade lights of the Grand Hotel to
the west.

rooms.name: Hill Street
rooms.desc:
This street is brightly lighted by the facade lights of the Grand Hotel to
the west.

rooms.name: Pearl Avenue
rooms.desc: The intersection of Pearl Avenue and Hill Street.

rooms.name: Pearl Alley
rooms.desc:
Pearl Alley is a narrow, dark road that runs east and west between the
southern city wall and the side of the Grand Hotel. To the east is the
brightly lit Pearl Street.

rooms.name: Pearl Alley
rooms.desc:
This is a dark alley that runs between the southern city wall and the
wall of the Grand Hotel. There's a small door to the north.

rooms.name: Beneath The Watchtower
rooms.desc:
You're in an open area beneath a city watchtower. There are some stairs up
here. There's a small dirt path to the north and Pearl Alley is to the east.

rooms.name: Inside The Watchtower
rooms.desc: Unexpectedly, this room looks more like an office than a watch station.

rooms.name: City Vault
rooms.desc:
It looks like a big hole in the ground. You wonder if there might be
buried treasure here.... The ground feels loose under your feet.

rooms.name: Dirt Trail
rooms.desc: This is a small dirt trail running north and south by the city wall.

rooms.name: Bloody Eddie's
rooms.desc:
This place was once reputed to serve the finest seafood in the known
universe, but from the looks of this dump, it must have been a very, very
long time ago.  Sawdust litters the floors, while large holes gape wide
in the tablecloth.  The crude wallpaper hangs loosely and in tatters from 
the warping wood walls.
   A small blackboard hangs on the wall above the cash drawer.

rooms.name: Bloody Eddie's Bar
rooms.desc:
There's a long bar here with stools. A few more tables and chairs are
scattered about.

rooms.name: Docks
rooms.desc: You are standing on part of the docks of Amber.  A ship rocks docked here.

rooms.name: Docks
rooms.desc: Part of the docks of Amber. There is a gangplank north of here.

rooms.name: Gangplank
rooms.desc:
You find yourself moving gently up and down on a perfectly ordinary
gangplank. Suddenly you notice the ship is flying pirate colors. This
might not be such a good idea after all.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.desc:
You're in the lobby of the Grand Hotel and you've never seen such a
lavishly decorated room. Gold curtains hang upon marble columns, large
oil paintings adorn the walls, the carpet is deep burgundy in color and
very plush. There is a stair here going up. The Grand Niteclub is west;
the Grand Dining Room is south.

rooms.name: The Grand Nightclub
rooms.desc:
The lighting is dim but you can see that this is a fine nightclub that
probably offers up some good entertainment. In fact, there are some foxy
babes dancing on stage now. There is a placard here, on an easel by the door.

rooms.name: Grand Dining Room
rooms.desc:
This is a richly decorated dining room. The finest brocade tablecloths,
gleaming silverware, and the finest china. There is a swinging door leading
west from here.

rooms.name: Choice's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
There's a bed here that's big enough for Choice and a rather
powerfully-built, tall, blonde Ultrahuman that you possibly have
heard about. In fact, the bed seems to be occupied at this very moment
by someone comfortably buried beneath the sheets and pillows.
There's a huge picture window to the south, a fireplace to the east, and
bookshelves everywhere else. Thick bear skins cover the floor. A Macintosh
computer sits upon a nearby desk.

rooms.name: Second Floor
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the second floor of the inn.  Doors lead in all
cardinal directions into suites, while stairs lead up and down from
here.
   A sturdy door at the top of the stairs bears a faded set of letters
that read "Manager."

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: This is a large, well-stocked kitchen. Doors lead north, east, and south.

rooms.name: The Stage
rooms.desc: This is a small stage in the Grand Niteclub.

rooms.name: The Queen's Suite
rooms.desc:
You are in a lavish guest room in the Grand Hotel. A door lies west.
In the east corner stands a large bed, blankets are folded on it.

rooms.name: The Prince's Suite
rooms.desc:
You are in a lavish guest room in the Grand Hotel. A door lies north.
A small bed stands in the middle of the room.

rooms.name: The Princess Suite
rooms.desc: You are in a lavish guest room in the Grand Hotel. A door lies east.

rooms.name: The Manager's Office
rooms.desc:
You are in the office of the hotel manager. A door leads down. The
huge hotel safe is east.

rooms.name: The King's Suite
rooms.desc:
You are in a lavish guest room in the Grand Hotel. A door lies south.
A large king-sized bed stands in the middle of the room.

rooms.name: Sleazy Tattoo Parlor
rooms.desc:
You're in a sleazy tattoo parlor. There's sleazy artwork on all the walls.
There's a sleazy counter here.

rooms.name: Cult Of The Logrus
rooms.desc:
BRRRR! This is a creepy place. It seems to be some sort of secret temple.
There's an elaborate mosaic of a dragon on the wall. There's a stone altar
with reddish-brown stains on it.

rooms.name: The Altar Of The Unicorn
rooms.desc:
You're at the front of the Church. There's an altar here. Tapestries hang
high on the walls.

rooms.name: Amidships
rooms.desc: You're on deck of a sea-going warship. There is a hatch leading down.

rooms.name: Stern
rooms.desc: You on on deck of a sea-going warship.

rooms.name: Bow
rooms.desc: You are on deck of a sea-going warship.

rooms.name: Below Deck
rooms.desc:
You are below deck on a sea-going warship. The captain's quarter's
lie east from here, and the brig is west. Fresh sea air can be smealt
from the hatch leading up out of the hold.

rooms.name: Captain's Quarters
rooms.desc:
This looks like a bedroom for a seafaring man. In the east corner
stands something that looks like something a man could sleep on.

rooms.name: Brig
rooms.desc: This is the Brig. It's not a good place to be.

rooms.name: A Commercial Library
rooms.desc:
This looks like a good place to learn about Amber. There are signs on
the walls and administrative booklets and pamphlets on the shelves.  A
door leads back south.

rooms.name: Fiddler's Green
rooms.desc:
You are in the front hall of a private club called Fiddler's Green.
A door leads south out of the club, and west, further inside.

rooms.name: Main Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the main entertainment room of Fiddler's Green. There are a
variety of diversions available here. A door leads eastward.

rooms.name: Main Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the main entertainment area of Fiddler's Green. There are a
variety of diversions available here. There is a spiral staircase here.

rooms.name: Lounge
rooms.desc: You are upstairs in Fiddler's Green. The furnishings are plush.

rooms.name: Lounge
rooms.desc: You are upstairs in Fiddler's Green. The furnishings are plush.

rooms.name: Lounge
rooms.desc: You are upstairs in Fiddler's Green. The furnishings are plush.

rooms.name: Lounge
rooms.desc: You are upstairs in Fiddler's Green. The furnishings are plush.

rooms.name: Bank Vault
rooms.desc: You are in a very secure bank vault. The door is east.

rooms.name: Outside The West Gate Of Amber
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small clearing. To the east you see the entrance
to the city of Amber.

rooms.name: Southern Courtyard
rooms.desc: A small but elegant courtyard south of the main entrance to the castle.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is dark flagstone and the walls are white marble
streaked with bluish gray. A door leads south into a courtyard.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is dark flagstone and the walls are white marble streaked
with bluish gray. False arches and columns nearly hide the high, beamed
ceiling. There are large, colorful tapestries firmly affixed to the walls
here.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is of dark flagstone and the walls are white marble streaked
with bluish gray.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is dark flagstone and the walls are white marble streaked
with bluish gray. There are weapons and shields hanging high on the walls.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is dark flagstone and the walls are white marble streaked
with bluish gray.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is dark flagstone and the walls are white marble streaked
with bluish gray. There are vibrant tapestries firmly affixed to the walls here.

rooms.name: The Grand Stair
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a broad, ornate staircase that goes up to the second
floor.

rooms.name: The Grand Stair - 2nd Floor
rooms.desc: You are on a broad and ornate stair leading up and down.

rooms.name: The Grand Stair - 3rd Floor
rooms.desc: You are on a broad and ornate staircase that goes down.

rooms.name: The East Side Of The Great Hall
rooms.desc:
The Great Hall measures approximately 50 feet wide by 90 feet long. Its
beamed and plastered ceiling is almost 40 feet above the floor. Royal
weddings, coronations, and funerals occur here. On the south wall, doorways
lead to sitting rooms, while on the north wall two doors lead to a corridor
near the kitchen. A bar stands in the northwest corner. Light comes through
beveled windows from 25 feet up the west wall. The effect is almost prismatic
and the Hall takes on a beautiful, hypnotic shimmer. The deep green vein in
the white marble walls seems to slither its way from the ceiling to the floor.
Under a bright moon, the vein is predominant. The Great Hall at night is
eerie.

rooms.name: The Northeast Corner Of The Great Hall
rooms.desc:
The Great Hall measures approximately 50 feet wide by 90 feet long. Its
beamed and plastered ceiling is almost 40 feet above the floor. Royal
weddings, coronations, and funerals occur here. On the south wall, doorways
lead to sitting rooms, while on the north wall two doors lead to a corridor
near the kitchen. A bar stands in the northwest corner. Light comes through
beveled windows from 25 feet up the west wall. The effect is almost prismatic
and the Hall takes on a beautiful, hypnotic shimmer. The deep green vein in
the white marble walls seems to slither its way from the ceiling to the floor.
Under a bright moon, the vein is predominant. The Great Hall at night is
eerie.

rooms.name: Servants' Quarters
rooms.desc:
There is room here for many bunks, with screens to partition the area
a bit and provide some privacy. There is a door west.

rooms.name: Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
You are in a small room containing a spiral staircase. It must be the
stair that the servants use. Doors lie south and east.

rooms.name: Corridor
rooms.desc:
You are in a corridor near the servants' quarters. Doors lead
north and south.

rooms.name: Corridor
rooms.desc: You are in a corridor near the kitchen and the servants' quarters.

rooms.name: Corridor
rooms.desc: You are in a short corridor near the kitchen. A door leads south.

rooms.name: Bar
rooms.desc:
You are near a small, well-stocked wet bar. When you look into the
bar you see several bottles of wine standing in it. Behind them
is a bottle of whiskey. Doors go north and south.

rooms.name: The Southeast Corner Of The Great Hall
rooms.desc:
The Great Hall measures approximately 50 feet wide by 90 feet long. Its
beamed and plastered ceiling is almost 40 feet above the floor. Royal
weddings, coronations, and funerals occur here. On the south wall,
doorways lead to sitting rooms, while on the north wall two doors lead
to a corridor near the kitchen. A bar stands in the northwest corner.
Light comes through beveled windows from 25 feet up the west wall. The
effect is almost prismatic and the Hall takes on a beautiful, hypnotic
shimmer. The deep green vein in the white marble walls seems to slither
its way from the ceiling to the floor. Under a bright moon, the vein is
predominant. The Great Hall at night is eerie.

rooms.name: Southwest Corner Of The Great Hall
rooms.desc:
Immediately above you is the musicians' loft. Above that are the windows.
There are shields from the Golden Circle Kingdoms securely affixed to the wall
here.

rooms.name: The West Side Of The Great Hall
rooms.desc:
Immediately above you is the musicians' loft. Above that are the beveled
windows. There are shields of the Golden Circle Kingdoms securely affixed to
the wall here.

rooms.name: The Northwest Corner Of The Great Hall
rooms.desc:
The Great Hall measures approximately 50 feet wide by 90 feet long. Its
beamed and plastered ceiling is almost 40 feet above the floor. Royal
weddings, coronations, and funerals occur here. On the south wall,
doorways lead to sitting rooms, while on the north wall two doors
lead to a corridor near the kitchen. A bar stands in the corner west
of here. There is a statue of the Unicorn here.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc: This is a short hallway going north and south.

rooms.name: Throne Storage Room
rooms.desc:
This is a small, plain storage room where the Throne of Amber is stored
when it is not needed in the Great Hall for official occasions. A door
stands on the south wall.

rooms.name: The Great Stair
rooms.desc:
You are on a huge stone spiral stair. It appears to have been carved
from the solid rock of Mt. Kolvir. A door leads north.

rooms.name: The Great Stair
rooms.desc:
You are on a huge stone spiral stair that seems to have been carved from the
solid rock of Kolvir.

rooms.name: Musicians' Loft
rooms.desc:
This is a small balcony over the Great Hall where the musicians sit
and play.

rooms.name: Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
This is a small, comfortable room where small groups can visit. A door
leads north.

rooms.name: Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
This is a small, comfortable room where small groups can visit. A door
leads north.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This appears to be the part of the kitchen where the finishing touches
are made to the food and it is placed on trays for serving.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: This appears to be the main area where food is prepared.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: This appears to be where the dishes and stuff are cleaned.

rooms.name: Nook
rooms.desc:
This small, cheerful area is probably where the servants eat and where
members of the royal family sneak midnight snacks. A door leads west into
a garden.

rooms.name: Garden Path
rooms.desc: You're on a pretty, little path.

rooms.name: Benedict's Japanese Garden
rooms.desc:
Here is a perfectly lovely meditation garden. The sands and stones,
plants and waters are laid out in perfect harmony among themselves. Oddly,
there seems to be an underlying pattern to the garden that is almost
familiar.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc: You are in a hallway. There is a door on the south wall.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc: You are in a hallway.

rooms.name: Small Library
rooms.desc: This is a small library, presumedly for the use of family and friends.

rooms.name: The Yellow Room
rooms.desc:
This is a small sitting room where the King of Amber conducts official
business. The floors and walls are constructed of a yellowish stone.
Doors lead north and east.

rooms.name: Guard Room
rooms.desc: This looks like a room used by guards. Doors lead east and west.

rooms.name: Counting Room
rooms.desc:
This appears to be a room where money could be counted. Doors lead
north and west.

rooms.name: Treasury
rooms.desc:
This looks like the kind of place where money, records, and valuables
might be stored. An iron door lies on the south wall.

rooms.name: Reading Room
rooms.desc:
This is a small, comfortable room that looks like a good place to read a
book. There is a fireplace against the west wall.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc: You are in a small hallway.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc: You are in a hallway. A door lies in the north wall.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: You are in a comfortable sitting room for guests of the castle.

rooms.name: Guest Bedroom
rooms.desc:
You are in a comfortable bedroom for guests of the castle.
A large, comfortable bed stand in the north corner of the room.

rooms.name: Atrium
rooms.desc:
You are in a courtyard that is open to the outside but somehow protected
from the weather. The view out the east wall is stunning, looking straight
off the cliff of Kolvir.

rooms.name: Guard Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a large guard room in front of the Armory. A door leads
south from here.

rooms.name: Lounge
rooms.desc:
If you didn't know better, you wouldn't know you were in a huge castle.
This cozy room has warm wood paneling and a low, textured ceiling. There's
a friendly circular fireplace set into the floor at the room's center.

rooms.name: Atrium
rooms.desc: You are in the odd court.

rooms.name: Atrium
rooms.desc: You are in the strange court.

rooms.name: Armory
rooms.desc:
You are in the castle armory. New and antique weapons are probably stored
here.

rooms.name: Armory
rooms.desc: You are in the castle armory.

rooms.name: Billiards Room
rooms.desc: How can you play pool on this table? It has no pockets!

rooms.name: Small Bar
rooms.desc:
You are near a small, well-stocked wet bar. Inside the bar are
a few bottles with alcoholic contents. There is a sign here.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor is a light-gray marble with bluish gray streaks. There is
a door south from here.

The floor here is of light-gray marble with bluish gray streaks. A

The floor here is of light-gray marble with bluish-gray streaks. There

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.desc:
This bathroom has an emerald-green floor and jade-green walls. The toilet
and tub appear to be carved from solid white marble. There is a door in the
west wall.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is of light-gray marble with bluish-gray streaks. There
is a door heading south and the way back through the secret toilet lies
north from here.

rooms.name: Brand's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
Eclectic and tasteless, Brand's room reflects the man's volatile
temperament. A door is in the north wall.

rooms.name: Brand's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
The bed is unmade and the remains of the last meal he ate here before
his death still rest in dishes on the floor. Chains have been embedded
in the wall in one corner and there is a small pile of ashes near them.
Several papers - essays on magic and the Pattern - lie scattered on the
desk. Old and brittle, they are as useless as the vials and jars of
unidentified substances that are pushed to the back.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc: The floor here is of light-gray marble with bluish-gray streaks.

The floor here is of light-gray marble with bluish-gray streaks. There
is a door heading west.

rooms.name: Corwin's Room
rooms.desc:
Corwin's decorating tastes appear to run to the functional and 
austere. Doors go north and east.

rooms.name: Corwin's Bath
rooms.desc:
Corwin apparently likes a good soak. There's a huge sunken tub here with
jacuzi jets. There is a panel in the wall to the south and a door goes west.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor is black marble here. A door is on the south wall and
a panel bars the way north.

rooms.name: Small Staircase
rooms.desc: You are on a small spiral staircase that goes up from here.

rooms.name: Deirdre's Bedroom
rooms.desc: The bedroom is tasteful, modern, and expensive. The bed is made with a lovely quilt and the room is immaculate.

rooms.name: Deirdre's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
The sitting room is decorated in an elegant, modern Manhattan-style.
The chairs are geniune Frank Lloyd Wright designs. A door goes west.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is of light-gray marble with bluish-gray streaks. There
are doors on the east and west walls.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.desc: You are in a bathroom decorated in black and silver. It's very striking.

rooms.name: Fiona's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
This room is tastefully decorated in the style called contemporary
Scandinavian on Shadow Earth. A door goes north.

rooms.name: Fiona's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
The Scandinavian designs emphasize simplicity and sparseness, which Fiona
turned to very good advantage here.

rooms.name: Fiona's Bath
rooms.desc:
The room features sleek, flowing fixtures which blend functionality and
simple elegance.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc: The floor here is of light-gray marble with bluish-gray streaks.

rooms.name: Dining Hall
rooms.desc:
You are in a small dining hall, probably used by the family when they
don't take their meals in their rooms. A door is on the north wall.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc:
You are in the library. This one is much larger than the one downstairs.
There are books all over the place!

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc: There is a spiral staircase here. A door is on the north wall.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc:
You are in the library. This one is much larger than the one downstairs.
There are books all over the place!

There are books all over the place!

rooms.name: Eric's Room
rooms.desc:
Eric's room is decorated in no particular style but it is, for the most
part, neat and accessible. A small bed stands in the middle of the room.
A door goes south.

rooms.name: Eric's Bath
rooms.desc: This is a neat and functional room.

rooms.name: Julian's Room
rooms.desc:
This room has rugs and furniture made from various animal skins. A bed
with animal skins on it stands in a corner. A door exits south.

rooms.name: Julian's Bath
rooms.desc:
The hunter's motif is extended to the bath. There's a huge sunken tub
with a small waterfall.

rooms.name: Gerard's Room
rooms.desc:
Gerard's room reflects his physical orientation. A huge dragon's head
hangs stuffed and mounted on the far wall. Gerard is less than tidy and
there are many items scattered about. A door leaves east.

rooms.name: Gerard's Room
rooms.desc:
Unlike all his siblings, Gerard preferred to eliminate the interior walls in
his apartment in favor of one large, uninterrupted living space. His bed is in
this portion of the room.

rooms.name: Benedict's Front Room
rooms.desc:
Benedict has imported all his furnishings from one specific shadow,
pre-nineteenth century Japan of Shadow Earth. Upon entering this room,
visitors are expected to remove their shoes. Doors go north and west.

rooms.name: Benedict's Back Room
rooms.desc:
Benedict has converted this room into a combination bedroom and Japanese
garden bath. A door leads east.

rooms.name: Caine's Living Room
rooms.desc:
Although not as motif-oriented as some, Caine's apartments clearly reflect
his interests in naval and military matters. Doors go east and west.

rooms.name: Caine's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
The bedroom maintains the nautical motif.  A door goes east.
You see a bed standing in a corner of the room.

rooms.name: Bleys' Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
Bleys's rooms are very untidy. His bookshelves are lined with books on
all sorts of magics, chess, military history, heraldry, weapons design,
and ship construction. Doors lead east and west.

rooms.name: Bleys' Bedroom
rooms.desc:
Bleys' bedroom is sparse and untidy. There are various unidentified 
magical items about. His books are mostly arcane and linguistically
impenetrable. There is a door on the east wall.

rooms.name: Merlin's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
Merlin's room reflects his esoteric tastes. A large, colorful Oriental rug
depicting a hunting scene covers the floor. Its line of trees overwhelms the
entire room. The furniture is simple, perhaps to counter the rug's dominance.
Doors lead north and south.

rooms.name: Merlin's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
Merlin's bedroom has high ceilings and is filled with magickal clutter
and other bric-a-brac.  A massive ancient astrological device has been
mounted on the western wall.  Books and bookshelves dominate the rest of
this room, in some places large volumes are stacked on the floor as high
as your head! The only apparent exit is through the door to the north.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.desc:
The floor here is bluish-gray marble with black streaks. You can see the
library downstairs to the south. There is a spiral staircase here. A single
door leads north.

rooms.desc: You are in a passage for servants.

The floor here is bluish-gray marble with black streaks. You can look over
the railing and see down into the library to the south. A door heads north.

rooms.name: The King's Entry
rooms.desc:
The entryway to the King's office. Do you have an appointment?  A door
leads north.

rooms.name: King's Waiting Room
rooms.desc:
You are waiting in the King's waiting room. It's very comfortable here.
A door goes south.

rooms.name: The King's Office
rooms.desc:
This is the official offices of the King of Amber and it contains all
the lavish trappings of a powerful liege. The room also has powerful
spells placed on it to prevent the King from being influenced by magic.
Doors go north and west.

rooms.name: Conservatory
rooms.desc:
This was once a part of the office but Random has had it walled off to
provide him a place to practice his drums. South and east lie doors.

rooms.name: Royal Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the personal sitting room of the royal couple. It's very
comfortable, a great place for a casual visit.  Doors head north,
south, and east.

rooms.name: Royal Bath
rooms.desc: This is the royal couple's bath. It's quite large. A door heads west.

rooms.name: Royal Bedroom
rooms.desc:
You are in the royal couple's bedroom. A large, comfortable bed is
standing in the middle of the room. There is a fireplace to the east
and a door leads north.

rooms.name: Behind The Fireplace
rooms.desc: A dark, unfurnished room.

rooms.name: Vialle's Studio
rooms.desc:
You are in an artist's studio. Several unfinished sculptures are about.
A door goes south.

rooms.name: Small Staircase
rooms.desc: You are on a small staircase that goes down. A door leads east.

rooms.name: Dworkin's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
Dworkin's bedroom is sparsely furnished. It's dusty and looks like it
hasn't been used in years. Doors go west and south.

rooms.name: Dworkin's Library
rooms.desc:
Everything is covered with dust here. You hesitate to touch anything.
A door leads north into the bedroom.

rooms.name: Dworkin's Study
rooms.desc:
This would be a very comfortable place to sit if there were any chairs
and if it wasn't so dusty in here. There is a fireplace here. That's
probably where the dust has blown in.

rooms.name: Behind The Fireplace
rooms.desc: A dark, unfurnished room.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc:
The guest room is sparsely but comfortably furnished. A door leaves
north from here.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: This part of the guest room is for sleeping.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc:
This guest room is elegantly and comfortably furnished. A door
heads north out of the room.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: This part of the guest room is the sleeping quarters.

rooms.name: Lab
rooms.desc:
This looks like the family laboratory. However, there are also a number
of medical supplies about. It appears that this room served as a hospital
as well. A door is in the south wall.

rooms.name: Llewella's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
Llewella's apartments reflect her fascination with Venus, the Graeco-
Roman goddess of love, whom she claims to have met during her first
Shadow-shift. Her rooms bear a beautiful seashell motif. Doors head east and
west.

rooms.name: Llewella's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
The bedroom continues and extends the seashell motif. A door heads
east out of here.

rooms.name: Martin's Room
rooms.desc:
Martin's room looks like any guest room. He must not be in Amber much.
A door goes north from here.

rooms.name: Martin's Bedroom
rooms.desc: Martin's bedroom is as devoid of personal artifacts as the front room.

rooms.name: Flora's Sitting Room
rooms.desc:
Flora's furnishings are French, from the Napoleonic era. There is a large
oil painting on the wall.

rooms.name: Flora's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
The bedroom also features furnishings from the Napoleonic period. A bright
red canopied bed occupies most of the room.

rooms.name: Flora's Bath
rooms.desc:
One of the most outlandish baths you've ever seen, it carries the
French-style decor into its historically weakest area. Little, cute
statues spout water into a large, shell-shaped tub. The fixtures are
gold on the sink, toilet, and - what's that thing? Oh, a bidet.

rooms.name: Fencing Room
rooms.desc:
This room is used as a training room. Apparently, some swordfighting
goes on here. The room continues to the north. A door goes west.

rooms.name: Steam Room
rooms.desc: There's steam all over! And it's hot in here.

rooms.name: Weight Room
rooms.desc:
If anyone lifts these weights, they must be superhuman. A doorway
leads west and the fireplace on the east wall looks large enough to
crawl into.

rooms.name: Behind The Fireplace
rooms.desc: A dark, unfurnished room.

rooms.name: Racquetball Court
rooms.desc: This area looks just like a racquetball court.

rooms.name: The Great Stair
rooms.desc:
You are on a huge, stone spiral staircase.  It appears to have been carved
from the solid rock of Kolvir. There is on note on the step here, held in 
place by a large silver dagger stuck through it and into the stone.

You stand in a narrow space between the wall and some glowing lines on
the floor to the east that pulse with deadly energy. The room itself is
large; its ceiling and walls lost in shadows.
   To the west you see a door. A charred bird skeleton lies left to decay 
at its base, proclaiming that whatever lies outside the pattern is deadly.

infused within this mystical symbol tear your puny mortal body to shreds.


The Great Pattern has unmade you.

rooms.name: The Armory
rooms.desc:
This is a clean looking shop which sports a foundry in the back, they
must make all these armors in house, instead of trading for them. Most
of the pieces are complete suits designed specifically for the royal family
of Amber, but it looks like the blacksmith has enough talent to repair or
replace any armor you can specify.

rooms.name: Stven's Armaments
rooms.desc:
This store contains a wide variety of swords, axes, and other weaponry
that a soldier or adventurer might purchase.  Most of the armaments are
displayed on the walls or hung from the ceiling, you'd hate to be nearby
if any of those swords hung from the crossbeam fell.
